claim:
Text: "Video shows attack of French embassy in Sudan"
Claim author: Anmol Alphonso
Claim date: October 28, 2020
Claim origin: https://www.boomlive.in/fake-news/2012-embassy-attacks-in-sudan-falsely-shared-as-attack-on-french-embassy-10392
before_justification: The fact-check concludes that the claim is **refuted** because the video, [verified by BOOM](https://www.boomlive.in/fake-news/2012-embassy-attacks-in-sudan-falsely-shared-as-attack-on-french-embassy-10392), is actually from **September 2012** and shows protesters storming and setting fire to the **German Embassy in Khartoum**, Sudan, not the French embassy. The footage was authentic but was being falsely shared with a misleading context in 2020, with no official confirmation of any attack on the French embassy at that time.
after_justification: The fact-check concludes the circulated video is not from 2020 but repurposes footage from embassy attacks in Sudan in **2012** that was falsely recirculated and mislabeled. Analysis by fact-checker Anmol Alphonso on [Boom Live](https://www.boomlive.in/fake-news/2012-embassy-attacks-in-sudan-falsely-shared-as-attack-on-french-embassy-10392) identified the video as misleading, determining it does not authentically depict the event claimed.

adopted_qa_evidence.question: Is the footage in the video from a different time, location, or event that has been mislabeled as an attack on the French embassy in Sudan?
adopted_qa_evidence.answer: Based on the search result provided, the claim appears to be **not entirely false** in that the video was "first uploaded on October 28, 2020, confirming the attack on the French embassy occurred that same day." This suggests the footage aligns with the date and event described in the claim. However, the claim origin (boomlive.in) indicates the video may actually depict embassy attacks from Sudan in **2012** that were being falsely recirculated in 2020 as a French embassy attack. The search result alone does not provide enough definitive evidence to confirm whether the footage is genuinely from 2020 or is recycled from the 2012 embassy attacks in Sudan. Further investigation would be needed to determine whether the footage is mislabeled.

adopted_qa_evidence.answer: Based on the Record provided, yes, Anmol Alphonso published an article on October 28, 2020, on the fact-checking website Boom Live (boomlive.in) analyzing this specific video claim. The article, with the title indicating that "2012 Embassy Attacks in Sudan [Were] Falsely Shared as Attack on French Embassy," investigated the video purporting to show an attack on the French embassy in Sudan and identified it as misleading.

Im Sudan wurde die deutsche Botschaft am Freitag von wütenden Demonstranten angegriffen, in Brand gesteckt und erheblich zerstört.
Alle Mitarbeiter seien wohlauf, versicherte Außenminister Guido Westerwelle (FDP). Gewalt gab es nach den traditionellen Freitagsgebeten in vielen islamischen Ländern, von Bangladesch bis Tunesien.

Die Polizei setzte Tränengas ein und konnte die Angreifer mit Mühe abwehren. Auch die britische Botschaft in der Stadt wurde attackiert.
